artifact.bias_note: A pre-existing informal misshelve log exists (the closers' daily tally) but has never been checked for rater agreement -- not trusted until T-12 passes.

logistics.sample_size_rationale: Engine sample-size panel, proportion calculator: planning p 0.05, margin 1.5 points at 95% confidence returns n=811; 21 audit days at ~65/day (~1,380) clears it.
logistics.where_collected: Shelf-read audit of daily assigned ranges

artifact.notes: Rework after T-12 round 1 failed (kappa 0.336, EXIT-02): the four written shelving-defect rules now pin the judgment call. Sampling scheme for T-21: subgroup = one day's audited books across the rotating ranges, both shifts' shelving mixed.

operational_definition.how_instrument: Daily shelf-read audit of that day's two assigned ranges per section, judged against the four written rules above
operational_definition.starts_when: Book is scanned into the audit range
operational_definition.stops_when: Auditor records pass/fail against the written rules
operational_definition.what_measured: A book is correctly shelved only if a patron walking the call-number order would find it: (1) exact call-number order -- ANY out-of-order placement fails, one slot or one bay; (2) juvenile series shelve by the posted series-title-then-volume scheme -- by-author placement in a series section fails; (3) oversize titles belong in the oversize section WITH a dummy marker at the home slot -- marker present passes, absent fails; (4) a book lying flat on top of a row is not shelved -- fails.
